Joining the voice cast including Ariel Winter who returns as Princess Sofia, are Nate Torrence (“Zootopia”) as Pepper, Sofia’s adorable, yet mischievous pet puppy-unicorn, Mela Pietropaolo (“Cocomelon Lane”), Kai Harris (“Paw Patrol”) and newcomer Aaliyah Magcasi, will voice Layla, Zane and Camila, Sofia’s new school friends. 

Darcy Rose Byrnes and Jess Harnell will return as fan-favorite characters Princess Amber and Cedric, respectively. They join other previously announced returning cast members Wayne Brady (Clover), Tim Gunn (Baileywick), Eric Stonestreet (Minimus), Sara Ramirez (Queen Miranda) and Travis Willingham (King Roland). 

Princess Sofia of Enchancia is headed to a brand new school – the Charmswell School for Royal Magic. With her royal friends, Princess Layla, Princess Camila, and Prince Zane—as well as school castle pet, Pepper the Puppercorn—Sofia will find out what being the most magical princess in the EverRealm is all about. A whole enchanted world is waiting for her as Sofia embarks on exciting adventures with new friends and old, her royal family and loyal animal pals.

recentItems.title: Megan asks Cupcake about his favorite things! 🧁✨ | Megan and Cupcake Shorts | Disney Jr.
recentItems.description:
Watch this Megan and Cupcake short, "Let's Play the Question Game: Cupcake ". Megan asks Cupcake super fun questions about his favorite things — from his favorite color to his favorite song! 

Wonder and learn with Megan and Cupcake as we Get Ready for Preschool! Megan and Cupcake will inspire kids to develop a love for learning through exploration, a little bit of magic, and a whole lot of fun, all with the help of Disney Jr characters! It's so magical when we learn something new.

“Marvel’s Iron Man and his Awesome Friends” follows the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses — Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho — as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city. In order to help them save the day, the Iron Friends each have their own Iron Suits that allow them to fly and give them enhanced super-strength.
